name: @tach/native-test
description: Public native Vulkan integration harness for Tach-generated modules

scripts.check: deno lint build.ts examples.ts && deno check --node-modules-dir=manual build.ts examples.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && spirv-val --target-env vulkan1.3 generated/kernel.spv && deno run --allow-ffi --allow-read --node-modules-dir=manual examples.ts
